tasks.InitialAmountCalculation: Calculate the initial amount of money Bailey started with based on her weekly allowance and total money after 8 weeks.

Answers.content:
To calculate the initial amount of money Bailey started with, we can use the following formula:

\[ \text{Initial Amount} = \text{Total Money After 8 Weeks} - (\text{Weekly Allowance} \times \text{Number of Weeks}) \]

Given:
- Total Money After 8 Weeks = $100
- Weekly Allowance = $5
- Number of Weeks = 8

Substituting the given values into the formula:

\[ \text{Initial Amount} = 100 - (5 \times 8) \]
\[ \text{Initial Amount} = 100 - 40 \]
\[ \text{Initial Amount} = 60 \]

So, Bailey started with $60.
